summary: Optional dependency sourced from unpinned GitHub repository
details: package.json declares an optionalDependency `fca-unofficial` whose source is `github:VangBanLaNhat/fca-unofficial`, a mutable GitHub reference with no commit SHA or tag pin. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever is currently at that repository's HEAD and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains, meaning the controller of that GitHub repository can supply arbitrary code that executes on installer machines. The package's E2EE bridge code also require()s this dependency at module load time, so once resolved the fetched code is also loaded by consumers that import the package. The other matched patterns in the tarball (Buffer.from base64 decoding in E2EE message/ratchet/store modules, and `ping` tokens inside a vendored FFI/native bridge) are consistent with the package's stated end-to-end encryption and native-binding purpose and do not independently indicate exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
